title: Board of Health - July 14, 2025
meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description: Please see the attached document for public notices and meeting information, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; processes and timelines for written and oral submissions; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.

agenda_items.title: Roll Call
agenda_items.minutes: The Meeting was called to order by Chair Kitts at 5:00pm. The Board Secretary conducted roll call and all Members were in attendance, with the exception of Member Dudas.

agenda_items.title: Motion to Introduce Reports
agenda_items.minutes:
Chair Kitts welcomed members of the Ottawa Board of Health to the special meeting which was called for the purpose of discussion of the appointment of a new Medical Officer of Health for Ottawa.
The Chair reminded members that rules of order apply in closed session and emphasized the confidentiality of the discussion. She noted that Ottawa City Council is expected to consider the appointment at its meeting on July 23, and that no public announcement will be made until Council and the Ministry of Health have confirmed the decision. A public service announcement will follow, pending approval.
The Chair called for a motion to adopt the report on consent. As no members requested the item be held for discussion and no public delegations were registered, the Board did not enter closed session. The confidential report was carried as presented, with no discussion.

agenda_items.title: In Camera Items*
agenda_items.description:
NOTICE* 
In Camera Items are not subject to public discussion or audience. Any person has a right to request an independent investigation of the propriety of dealing with matters in a closed session. A form requesting such a review may be obtained, without charge, from the City’s website or in person from the Chair of this meeting. Requests are kept confidential pending any report by the Meetings Investigator and are conducted without charge to the Requestor.

sub_agendas_items.title: Appointment of a Medical Officer of Health - In Camera - Personal Matters About Identifiable Individual- Reporting Out Date: Upon Council Approval

motions.motion_text: BE IT RESOLVED THAT the report titled Appointment of a Medical Officer of Health – In Camera – Personal Matters About an Identifiable Individual. Reporting Out Date: Not to be Reported Out, be received and adopted.
